title: ProviderState
description: A ModelProvider's capacity as the operator last probed it, in the kubemoot_provider_state bucket, key <provider>.

maxParallel.description: How many calls it serves at once; at least 1.

activeCount.description: Calls in progress. The operator writes 0; tickets carry the live count.

ready.description: Whether the provider answered its probe.

lastProbedAt.description: When the operator wrote this entry, RFC 3339 in UTC. Readers treat an entry older than five minutes as stale.

loadedModelFootprintsMiB.description: Memory each loaded model takes, in MiB, by model.

availableModelFootprintsMiB.description: Size of each model the provider has but has not loaded, in MiB, by model.

contextLength.description: The provider's default context window, in tokens.

loadedModelContextLengths.description: The context window each loaded model runs with, in tokens, by model.
